provenance: Synthetic DiagramML controls independently regenerated and saved by the native reference application. Each case supplies exactly one fitted value measured from the initiating native shape; equality propagation predicts other instance dimensions. This does not test choosing a fitted value or text measurement. Controls cover proportional chains and fans in both directions, shadowed named declarations, wildcard groups, repeated instances, exclusion of the initiating instance from cross-property propagation, and own versus parent scoped references. Additional font controls test local equality groups and proportional font links in both directions; saved font sizes are compared only on text-algorithm shapes, not inherited cached text on probe shapes.
